Use this skill when the user wants a rendered promo film, article-to-video piece, product launch film, website-to-video piece, keynote reveal, kinetic typography sequence, text/icon transition promo, music-synced motion graphic, HTML/CSS/SVG/GSAP video, short-form vertical video, or a landing page/product story turned into
skills.why_zh: 作者是 md2wechat 那位（已在架的中文精品作者），HyperFrames 官方件对中文排版水土不服，这件专治那个。
skills.why_en: By the author of md2wechat (already on our shelves) — the official skills stumble on Chinese typography; this one fixes exactly that.

skills.name: handdraw-good-deed-story
skills.tagline_zh: 批量产出 35~45 秒竖屏手绘故事短片：黑白线条逐笔显影的那种质感，讲一个善行小故事，量产也不失手作感。
skills.tagline_en: Batch-produces 35–45s vertical hand-drawn story shorts — black-line reveal animation telling a small good-deed tale, handmade feel at scale.

skills.name: visual-design
skills.tagline_zh: 说句“做个落地页”，它直接交付成品级HTML——不靠模板，用规则锁死排版、配色、间距，颜值稳定在线。
skills.tagline_en: Say "make a landing page" and get a polished HTML file—no templates, just rules that lock in layout, color, and.
skills.desc_en: 直出好看的网页/落地页/banner/海报/产品介绍页/数据报告/简历/作品集等视觉物料——套一套设计系统，模型自由写自包含 HTML，颜值由规则锁死、不靠模板。用户说"做个网页/页面/落地页/banner/海报/报告页/作品集/简历"或"把这份内容做成网页版"时使用。⚠️ 不含信息检索：查天气/查行情/查股价/查数据请走对应连接器，不是本技能。
skills.why_zh: 同类靠模板拼凑，它靠设计系统硬编码——每次输出都像设计师亲手调过，且完全自包含，零依赖。
skills.why_en: Others stitch templates; this hardcodes a design system—every output looks hand-tuned, fully self-contained, zero dependencies.

skills.name: visualizer
skills.tagline_zh: 扔进Excel或CSV，秒变交互图表与看板。预算、销售、运营指标，自动挑最合适的图表类型，连颜色都替你配好。
skills.tagline_en: Drop in Excel/CSV, get interactive charts & dashboards. Auto-picks best chart type and colors for budgets, sales.
skills.desc_en: 当用户要求数据可视化、做图表、生成看板、数据仪表盘、可视化报告、Excel/CSV 转图表、预算/销售/运营等指标分析页面、Chart.js 可视化时使用。只处理数据可视化任务；纯网页、banner、海报、简历等非数据图表设计任务应交给 visual-design。
skills.why_zh: 同类工具要你手动选图表类型，它却能根据数据语义自动匹配，连配色都按品牌调性生成，省掉一半调整时间。
skills.why_en: Unlike tools that make you pick chart types, it auto-matches based on data semantics and generates brand-aware palettes, saving.

skills.name: algorithmic-art
skills.tagline_zh: 想要独一无二的生成艺术？用种子随机数，每次运行都是新画作。拖动参数，实时探索形态，不复制大师，只创造你的宇宙。
skills.tagline_en: Seeded randomness, interactive sliders—every run is a unique generative artwork. Explore flow fields & particles.
skills.desc_en: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration. Use this when users request creating art using code, generative art, algorithmic art, flow fields, or particle systems. Create original algorithmic art rather than copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.
skills.why_zh: 种子随机数让作品可复现，参数探索面板让调整即时可见，比纯随机更可控，比手写代码更直观。
skills.why_en: Seeded randomness ensures reproducibility, while interactive parameter exploration gives instant visual feedback—more control.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.tagline_zh: 受够千篇一律的AI页面？这个Skill专治“模板脸”，用设计细节和创意代码，让每个组件都像手工定制，一眼难忘。
skills.tagline_en: Tired of AI-generated pages that all look the same? This Skill kills the template face with crafted details and.
skills.desc_en: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, artifacts, posters, or applications (examples include websites, landing pages, dashboards, React components, HTML/CSS layouts, or when styling/beautifying any web UI). Generates creative, polished code and UI design that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
skills.why_zh: 它不堆组件库，而是从布局到微交互逐层定制，连阴影和间距都带设计意图，彻底摆脱AI味。
skills.why_en: It skips generic component kits, customizing layout to micro-interactions with intentional shadows and spacing—zero AI clichés.

skills.name: embedded-captions
skills.tagline_zh: 给已有的口播视频加字幕：不重渲染整片、逐句对齐口型节奏，字幕样式也按平台习惯来，短视频的标配工序它包了。
skills.tagline_en: Adds captions to an existing talking-head video without re-rendering the whole thing — phrase-level timing and platform-native caption styling.
skills.desc_en: Add captions or subtitles to an existing single-subject talking-head video without editing the footage. Use for plain verbatim captions, cinematic captions embedded behind the subject, VFX captions, “炸/特效/酷炫字幕,” or a named identity from the 35-style catalog. Route by visual identity, not by backend engine. The quiet `anchor` rail is the default; embed every word only when the user explicitly wants
skills.why_zh: 「不重渲染」是关键：改字幕不用等整片重跑，短视频反复调字幕的人会立刻感受到这个差别。
skills.why_en: No full re-render is the point — tweak captions without waiting on the whole clip; anyone iterating on shorts feels this instantly.

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.tagline_zh: 写代码前总被老板催着动手？先花3分钟用这个技能理清意图、需求和设计，避免返工。它会在你敲键盘前。
skills.tagline_en: Tired of coding before thinking? This skill makes you pause, explore intent, needs, and design first—so you build.
skills.desc_en: 在任何创造性工作之前必须使用此技能——创建功能、构建组件、添加功能或修改行为。在实现之前先探索用户意图、需求和设计。
skills.why_zh: 它把「头脑风暴」变成强制步骤，用结构化提问逼你挖出隐藏需求，比你自己拍脑袋想全面得多。
skills.why_en: It turns brainstorming into a mandatory, structured step—forcing you to uncover hidden needs via targeted questions, far more.

skills.name: faceless-explainer
skills.tagline_zh: 一篇文章、一堆笔记、甚至一个主题词丢进去，产出一支无需露脸的解说视频——不用出镜、不用配音演员，脚本到成片一条龙。
skills.tagline_en: Feed it an article, rough notes or just a topic and get a faceless explainer video out — no camera, no voice actor, script to final cut.
skills.desc_en: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.
skills.why_zh: 无脸口播是自媒体最好起量的形态，它把这条最费时的产线（脚本、画面、字幕、配音）整条自动化了。
skills.why_en: Faceless explainers are the easiest format to scale, and this automates the whole costly pipeline: script, visuals, captions, voice.

skills.name: design-review
skills.tagline_zh: 拿着设计简报和代码库逐项评审你的界面：视觉层级、间距、一致性、可用性挨个打分，评审意见对得上原始需求。
skills.tagline_en: Reviews your interface against the brief and the codebase — visual hierarchy, spacing, consistency and usability scored, critique tied back to intent.
skills.desc_en: Run a structured design critique against the brief and codebase. Checks visual hierarchy, consistency, responsiveness, accessibility, and aesthetic fidelity. Use when user wants a design review, critique, QA pass, polish pass, or mentions "review" after building.
skills.why_zh: 关键在「对着简报审」：不是泛泛说好看不好看，而是回答「这版有没有实现当初要解决的问题」。
skills.why_en: Reviewing against the brief is the point — not vague taste talk, but whether this build solves what it set out to.

skills.name: deepchat-cli
skills.tagline_zh: 当你想在终端里直接调模型、跑OCR、查MCP，又懒得开界面——这个Skill把DeepChat的CLI控制台搬进对。
skills.tagline_en: Skip the GUI—run DeepChat's CLI from chat for inference, OCR, MCP, and artifact checks, all in one command.
skills.desc_en: Use DeepChat's bundled CLI control plane for model inference, image/video/speech generation, transcription, OCR, artifact inspection, public configuration, Skills, and MCP operations. Activate when a user asks to invoke DeepChat capabilities that are not already exposed as a more specific tool, compare models, run a benchmark, inspect DeepChat runtime state, or manage DeepChat through the CLI.
skills.why_zh: 同类工具只做单点调用，它却把整个CLI控制面暴露给对话，连配置和技能管理都能聊着办。
skills.why_en: Unlike single-purpose wrappers, it exposes the full CLI control plane—config, skills, MCP—right inside your chat.

skills.name: impeccable
skills.tagline_zh: 像设计总监一样对页面做多轮体检：层级、间距、一致性、细节逐遍挑刺，直到那种「说不上哪不对」的别扭感消失。
skills.tagline_en: Inspects a page in multiple passes like a design director — hierarchy, spacing, consistency and detail, until the "something feels off" itch is gone.
skills.desc_en: Use when the user wants to design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, clarify, distill, harden, optimize, adapt, animate, colorize, extract, or otherwise improve a frontend interface. Covers websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, app shells, components, forms, settings, onboarding, and empty states. Handles UX review, visual hierarchy, information architecture, cognitive load, acc
skills.why_zh: 第一版做出来之后最难的是精修，它专攻这一段：不重做，只把已有页面的粗糙处一轮轮磨掉。
skills.why_en: Polish is the hardest stage after v1, and this owns it — no redesign, just pass after pass sanding down the roughness.

skills.name: openchatcut
skills.tagline_zh: 让AI直接上手你的剪辑工程，改字幕、调时间线、导出成片。不用再手动翻找素材，说句话就搞定。
skills.tagline_en: Let AI edit your local video project directly—timeline, captions, export. No manual digging, just ask.
skills.desc_en: Connect an MCP-capable coding agent to OpenChatCut and edit local video projects. Use when the user asks to install, connect, or set up OpenChatCut; inspect or edit an OpenChatCut project; work with its timeline, transcript, captions, media, generation, motion graphics, audio, color, or export tools; or recover from an OpenChatCut MCP error.
skills.why_zh: 同类工具只给API，它把MCP接进OpenChatCut，让AI能读能改工程文件，真正动手剪。
skills.why_en: Others just offer APIs; this wires MCP into OpenChatCut, letting AI read and modify real project files.

skills.name: skill-feedback-writer
skills.tagline_zh: 你的技能输出总差一步？让它自检漏洞。输入结果，它反向揪出缺失指令，连「忘了说保存」这种坑都给你标出来。
skills.tagline_en: Feed it your skill's output, it reverse-engineers the missing instructions—even the 'forgot to save' trap. Try.
skills.desc_en: Use to identify missing instructions in another skill based on its output.
skills.why_zh: 同类工具只测功能，它专测「指令完整性」——从结果反推缺口，连隐性假设都挖出来，像给技能做X光。
skills.why_en: Others test if it works; this one tests if your instructions are complete—reverse-maps gaps from output, exposing hidden.

skills.name: diff-risk-explainer
skills.tagline_zh: 代码改动看得头晕？粘贴 diff，三秒讲清改了什么、为什么改，还附风险提示，像同事帮你 review。
skills.tagline_en: Paste a diff, get a plain-English summary of what changed and why, plus risk flags—like a quick code review buddy.
skills.desc_en: Use to briefly explain small code diffs.
skills.why_zh: 同类工具只列变更，它却结合上下文推理意图，并标出潜在破坏点，省去逐行猜测。
skills.why_en: Others list changes; this one infers intent from context and flags breakage risks, saving you line-by-line guesswork.

skills.name: pr-comment-evaluator
skills.tagline_zh: PR 评论太冲？同事看了想拉黑？用这个 skill 测出每条评论的「礼貌分」，还能指出哪句最伤人。
skills.tagline_en: Is your PR comment too harsh? This skill scores politeness, flags the sharpest line, and turns snark into smooth.
skills.desc_en: Use to judge whether a PR review comment sounds polite.
skills.why_zh: 它不只看关键词，而是分析语气转折和上下文，连反讽都能识别，比简单词库准一个量级。
skills.why_en: Goes beyond keywords—detects sarcasm and tone shifts in context, outperforming simple word lists by a clear margin.

skills.name: lark-doc
skills.tagline_zh: 当你说“发到飞书”，它才出手；读、建、改、插图样样通。别家只会写文件，它能从豆包链接里挖出文档。
skills.tagline_en: Only acts when you say 'send to Lark'—reads, creates, edits, inserts images. Digs docs from doubao links, even.
skills.desc_en: 【何时用:仅当用户明确指向飞书/Lark(发到飞书、飞书文档等)时使用;泛指做个文档或PPT或表格或方案默认走本地工具,不要误用飞书】飞书云文档(Docx / Wiki 文档,v2 API):读取、创建、编辑文档内容,插入或下载图片附件;用户给出文档 URL 或 token 时使用。文档中嵌入的电子表格、多维表格、画板,先用本 skill 提取 token 再切到对应 skill。doubao.com 的 /docx/ 或 /wiki/ URL 也走本 skill。不负责文档评论管理,也不负责表格或 Base 的数据操作。
skills.why_zh: 同类工具只会读写文档，它却懂得先判断场景，不误用本地工具，还能自动提取内嵌表格的 token。
skills.why_en: Unlike generic doc tools, it gates on explicit Lark intent, avoids local-tool misuse, and auto-extracts tokens for embedded.

skills.name: website-to-hyperframes
skills.tagline_zh: 给一个网址，它抓下整个网站再做成一支视频：产品页、落地页、作品集自动变成可播放的演示片，宣发素材一键就有。
skills.tagline_en: Give it a URL: it captures the whole website and turns it into a video — product pages, landing pages and portfolios become playable demo reels.
skills.desc_en: Capture a website and create a HyperFrames video from it. Use when: (1) a user provides a URL and wants a video, (2) someone says "capture this site", "turn this into a video", "make a promo from my site", (3) the user wants a social ad, product tour, or any video based on an existing website, (4) the user shares a link and asks for any kind of video content. Even if the user just pastes a URL — t
skills.why_zh: 点子很妙：网站本来就是最完整的产品素材库，直接把它变成视频，省掉重新设计一遍宣传片的功夫。
skills.why_en: A clever premise — your site is already the most complete asset library, so turning it straight into video skips designing a promo from scratch.

skills.name: inspect
skills.tagline_zh: 截图前先扫雷：焦点环缺失、下拉被裁、z-index 乱、动效残废——真 Chromium 多视口截图。
skills.tagline_en: Scan for focus rings, clipped dropdowns, z-index crimes—then real Chromium screenshots on mobile/desktop to catch.
skills.desc_en: Use when the user wants to scan for design anti-patterns, take a browser screenshot, or do a design engineering code review. Covers: missing focus rings, clipped dropdowns, bad z-index, placeholder-as-label, missing reduced-motion (detect); real Chromium screenshots, mobile/desktop viewports, visual bug fixing (preview); motion crimes, accessibility violations, forbidden CSS patterns, token misuse
skills.why_zh: 同类只会静态检查，它真开浏览器截图，把动效和遮挡问题直接拍成证据，修 bug 不用靠猜。
skills.why_en: Others just lint; this one drives real Chromium, screenshots both viewports, and turns motion/overlay bugs into visual proof.

skills.name: audit
skills.tagline_zh: 一次跑完15个专家代理，SEO、前端缺陷、设计质量全查遍。别人只报问题，它给优先级行动清单，连视觉动效都不放过。
skills.tagline_en: One pass, 15 specialist agents: SEO, front-end bugs, and design quality merged into a scored report with.
skills.desc_en: Use when the user wants a complete, whole-site audit that combines search visibility, front-end defects, and design quality in one pass. Runs all 15 specialist sub-agents across SEO, accessibility/interaction/layout/code defects, and UX/visual/motion/content design, then merges them into one scored report with a prioritized action plan. Use for: 'audit my whole site', 'complete site audit', 'full
skills.why_zh: 同类工具只查单点，它把15个维度合成一张评分表，且按优先级排好行动项，省掉你逐份报告的拼凑时间。
skills.why_en: Unlike single-dimension tools, it fuses 15 audit streams into one scored, prioritized action plan—no more stitching reports.

skills.name: marketing-machine
skills.tagline_zh: 从扫描代码到出图出片，一条龙自动跑完。你只丢一句需求，它自己搭台、写稿、审规、渲染，连卡片和视频都按同一份HTML。
skills.tagline_en: Scan code, write copy, enforce rules, render PNG & MP4 from one HTML contract. Just say the word—it runs the.
skills.desc_en: Own the whole marketing content pipeline for this codebase — set itself up, scan the product for what actually works, write the copy, enforce the rules mechanically, and render cards (PNG) and video (MP4) from one HTML contract. Use for "set up marketing", "write a post", "review this copy", "make a card for this", "render a video", "scan the product", or "do the whole thing".
skills.why_zh: 同类工具只写文案，它却把产品扫描、规则校验和视觉渲染焊成一条链，且所有输出共用一份HTML契约。
skills.why_en: Unlike copy-only tools, it welds product scanning, rule enforcement, and PNG/MP4 rendering into one pipeline—all from a single.

skills.name: grill-me
skills.tagline_zh: 围着你的方案连续追问，把藏着的假设、遗漏和自相矛盾一个个问出来，问到双方真的想清楚了才收——榜单第一名，75 万安装。
skills.tagline_en: Interrogates your plan relentlessly, surfacing hidden assumptions, gaps and contradictions until you both actually understand it. The list's #1, 756K installs.
skills.desc_en: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree. Use when user wants to stress-test a plan, get grilled on their design, challenge an approach, or mentions "grill me".
skills.why_zh: 做重要决定前给自己做一轮压力测试，比事后返工便宜太多；它的狠劲在于不许你用「差不多想过了」蒙混过关。
skills.why_en: A stress test before big decisions costs far less than rework; its virtue is refusing to let "I've roughly thought it through" slide.

skills.name: bggg-creator-image2ppt
skills.tagline_zh: 把截图、海报、别人的 PPT 页面、HTML 或 SVG 设计稿，逆向成可编辑的 PPTX——不是贴张图，是还原成能改的元素。
skills.tagline_en: Reverse-engineers screenshots, posters, other people's slides, HTML or SVG into an editable PPTX — real editable elements, not a pasted image.
skills.desc_en: 把图片、截图、海报、PPT 页面截图、HTML 或 SVG 设计稿转换成可编辑 PPTX 的 Codex skill。 当用户需要 image2ppt、image2pptx、图片转 PPT、截图转 PPT、PNG/JPEG 转可编辑幻灯片、 HTML/SVG 转 PPTX、把设计图拆成图片组件和文本框再拼成 PowerPoint、 或希望复用 Codex 内置生图能力把平面图重建为多元素可编辑 PPT 时，应该使用此 skill。 在 Codex 中处理二进制图片时，默认结合 imagegen skill：先用 Codex 视觉理解版式， 再用内置图片生成/编辑能力生成或清理多个组件图片，最后用本 skill 的脚本拼装 PPTX。
skills.why_zh: 「看到一张好看的 PPT 页想照做」是真实高频需求，它输出的是可编辑元素而不是图片，这一步差别就是能不能用。
skills.why_en: "I want that slide, editable" is a real, frequent ask — and editable elements instead of a flat image is the difference between usable and not.

skills.name: bggg-creator-image2psd
